puzzle.hint: This closing verse of Surah Ar-Rahman extols Allah's majestic and honorable attributes, frequently recited in remembrance and supplication.
puzzle.arabic: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
puzzle.verseEn: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
